title: Databricks BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NULL VALUE
question:
We created table as below like, and first time load the data from SQL to insert the data to below tables, after the ID generated by default sequence is perfect, but we are insert the data any one column to manually or externally the ID is always insert the NULL values.

CREATE TABLE catalogname.schema.test(
    ID bigint  GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY  ,
    test1 string ,
    test2 string ,
    test3 string,
    test4 string ,
    test5 float ,
    test6 string ,
    Date timestamp 
)
USING DELTA
LOCATION "abfss://gold@teststroage.dfs.core.windows.net/test/data/test"
answer:
I have tried the below approach:

from pyspark.sql.types import *
source_schema = StructType([
    StructField("test1", StringType(), True),
    StructField("test2", StringType(), True),
    StructField("test3", StringType(), True),
    StructField("test4", StringType(), True),
    StructField("test5", FloatType(), True),
    StructField("test6", StringType(), True),
    StructField("Date", TimestampType(), True),
])
csv_path = "abfss://msgraph@urusstg.dfs.core.windows.net/test/sample.csv"
df = spark.read.option("header", "true").schema(source_schema).csv(csv_path)
create_table_query = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE hive_metastore.default.d (
    ID BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    test1 STRING,
    test2 STRING,
    test3 STRING,
    test4 STRING,
    test5 FLOAT,
    test6 STRING,
    Date TIMESTAMP
)
USING DELTA
LOCATION 'abfss://msgraph@urusstg.dfs.core.windows.net/test/sample';
"""
spark.sql(create_table_query)
df.write.format("delta").mode("append").saveAsTable("hive_metastore.default.d")
result = spark.sql("SELECT * FROM hive_metastore.default.d")
result.show()

In the above defining the schema excluding the ID column Reading the CSV file Create or replace the Delta table with an auto-incrementing ID column Writing the DataFrame to the Delta table
